title: Short-Form Video Editor for Founder-Led DTC Brand (Instagram Reels)
description:
I'm the founder of a growing golf brand in the U.S., and I'm looking for a talented short-form video editor to help turn my raw founder footage into engaging, story-driven Instagram Reels.

Most videos will be around 45–60 seconds and will typically start with footage of me speaking directly to camera. I'll provide the raw footage, script, and access to brand assets/B-roll when needed.

However, I'm NOT looking for someone who simply cuts out pauses, adds captions, throws in my B-roll, and calls it done.

I'm looking for an editor with strong creative judgment who understands storytelling, pacing, hooks, retention, music, and how to keep a short-form video visually interesting.

I want you to bring your own creativity to the edit.

If you think a section needs additional B-roll, a screenshot, graphic, sound effect, music, animation, screen recording, or another visual element, I want you to recognize that and add it. You should also be comfortable sourcing appropriate external B-roll or visual assets when it makes the story better rather than relying entirely on what I provide.

I can also provide examples of videos and editing styles I like so you have a strong reference for the direction I'm going for.

The goal is simple: I want to eventually be able to send you my raw footage + script and trust you to turn it into an engaging finished video without me having to tell you where every cut, B-roll clip, or visual should go.

### About the content

Our product is a golf glove, so a lot of our content is built around founder-led storytelling rather than simply showing the product.

Topics might include how I started the company, mistakes I've made building the brand, how our products are made, what makes them different, customer stories, our mission and giveback, industry recognition, and the behind-the-scenes reality of building a golf brand.

The editing should help tell that story.

I'm looking for videos that feel orgranic, natural, fast-moving, and engaging without being obnoxiously over-edited. Think strong visual storytelling—not random effects just for the sake of keeping something on screen.

### Project details

- Typical finished video: 45–60 seconds
- Format: Vertical 9:16
- Rate: $100 per finished video
- Project-based/freelance work
- Potential for consistent future projects if we're a great fit
- I'll provide raw footage, scripts, brand assets, and creative references
- You should be comfortable sourcing additional appropriate visuals/B-roll w

Editing style
Our main editing reference is EddieDoesMath.
We’re looking for a similar approach to pacing and visual storytelling:
- Fast-paced, retention-focused editing

- Maths questions, equations and working made large and easy to read on mobile
- Split-screen layouts between the presenter and whiteboard/working
- Punch-ins, zooms and reframing where appropriate
- Highlighting parts of equations or whiteboards as they’re being explained
- On-screen questions, multiple-choice answers and timers
- Simple low level motion graphics and animated text
- Sound effects used intentionally rather than on every cut
- Visual changes throughout the video to help maintain attention
- Humour/reaction editing when the format calls for it

The goal is not overly flashy editing. The Maths still needs to be easy to understand. We want someone who understands how to make educational content entertaining without making it distracting.

I’m now looking for someone who can take over that workload while maintaining that standard. This means I’m not simply looking for someone who can cut footage together and add captions. I’m looking for someone who can understand why an edit works, make strong creative decisions, and improve the pacing, clarity and retention of the content.

A big part of this role is understanding short-form retention-

“First we need to rearrange the equation and then factorise it”

STEP 2: FACTORISE
You should be able to make editing decisions like this yourself.

- Fast pacing with constant movement: punch-ins, zooms and cuts on almost every beat so the viewer never gets bored

- Animations that pop in at the right moment and never cover the speaker's face
- Music that's clearly audible but sits under the voice, and never sounds cheesy

1. A reusable style system the agent can follow: caption styles, transition presets, an SFX map, graphic templates, and rules for timing and placement.
2. Written instructions or skills the agent loads, so any new raw clip goes through the same process.

title: Influencer Outreach Specialist — TikTok/Instagram/YouTube Creator Seeding for Book Launch
description:
I'm the author of Choose Your Work, a self-help book for professionals who feel stuck or unfulfilled despite outward career success. I'm running an organic creator seeding campaign — sending free copies to creators and letting the book speak for itself. No paid sponsorships, no scripts, no obligations.

I need someone to send personalized outreach messages to approximately 1,000 creators across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Twitter/X — writing as me (the author), from my accounts, in my voice. This is not mass outreach. Every message needs to reference something specific about the creator's content.

What the role involves:

- Reviewing each creator's recent content to find a genuine connection point to the book's themes (career dissatisfaction, burnout, feeling trapped by success, career identity, personal growth)
- Writing and sending a short, personalized DM (3–4 sentences) from my account in my voice
- Managing replies — collecting shipping addresses, confirming dispatch, sending a brief follow-up two weeks after delivery
- Tracking everything in a shared spreadsheet: contacted, replied, address received, book shipped, follow-up sent, posted
- Working in phased batches starting with 200, then scaling based on response rates

What I'm looking for:

- Native or fully fluent English — the messages need to read like a real person talking, not a template
- Experience with influencer outreach specifically, not just general social media management
- Ability to watch a creator's video and write a relevant, personalized opening line quickly
- Strong organizational skills to manage a pipeline of 1,000 contacts across multiple stages

A creator list with thematic notes and relevance scoring will be provided — you don't need to do the initial research.

To apply, please answer this question:

Describe a past influencer or creator outreach campaign you've run. How many creators did you contact, what was your response rate, and what did the outreach message look like? Please include a sample DM or message you've sent in a previous campaign.

Also include your proposed rate (hourly or per-message) and estimated weekly capacity.
